name: chiipin
description: Split bills with friends and housemates: see who owes whom, add and split bills, and record payments.

interface.longDescription:
Chiipin keeps track of shared costs with the people you travel and live with. Connect it to ask who owes whom, see recent bills and upcoming household bills like rent, add a bill and split it, record a payment someone made you, and confirm or decline payments waiting on you.

Chiipin only keeps the record — it never moves money. Bills and payments you add here appear in the Chiipin iPhone app and on the web for everyone in the group.

You sign in with the same Apple or Google account you use in Chiipin and choose what to allow. Disconnect any time in Chiipin under Profile › Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: Who owes me money in Chiipin?
Add a $60 dinner to my Lisbon trip, split evenly.
What household bills are due this month?

positive.prompt: Who owes me money in Chiipin, and whom do I owe?
positive.expected_behavior: Taylor Kim owes you 30.00; you owe Morgan Lee 194.80 (Lisbon trip 238.00, Elm Street apartment -43.20).

positive.description: Add a bill and split it evenly
positive.prompt: Add a $60 dinner to my Lisbon trip, split evenly between all of us.
positive.expected_behavior: Bill "Dinner" 60.00 added to Lisbon trip, paid by you, 20.00 each for App Reviewer, Morgan Lee and Taylor Kim.

positive.prompt: Taylor says they paid me $12. Confirm it.
positive.expected_behavior: The 12.00 payment from Taylor Kim is confirmed; Taylor now owes you 18.00.

positive.description: Record a payment made outside Chiipin
positive.prompt: I paid Morgan back $100 for the Lisbon apartment rental.
positive.expected_behavior: A 100.00 payment from you to Morgan Lee in Lisbon trip is recorded, waiting for Morgan to confirm.

positive.prompt: What household bills are due in the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Internet 60.00 on the 15th and/or Rent 2400.00 on the 1st, whichever fall in the window, in Elm Street apartment.

negative.description: Moving money: Chiipin cannot send money, so no tool should claim to; the assistant explains Chiipin only records payments and offers to record one that already happened.
Unrelated request: no Chiipin tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Lisbon this week?

negative.description: Other people's contact details: Chiipin never returns other members' email addresses, so the assistant says it is not available.

review.commerce_description: Chiipin records bills and payments between people. It does not sell anything and never moves money.

publication.release_notes: First release: read balances, bills, household bills and pending payments; add and split bills; record, confirm or decline payments; mark your share paid.
